title: First Light
description: Build connections between miniature planets, then watch farms, industry and cargo traffic give rise to homes and businesses. Inspect each neighborhood’s history and suppliers.
imageAlt: First Light v0.10: a repair shop, its founding history, and highlighted connections to the clay brickworks and resident customers.
note: Places with a Past: causal town businesses, Ochre’s sulfur seas and Rook’s cratered gray moon. Standalone release with editable source and 39 simulation tests.

title: Silt + Signal
description: Scavenge a flooded world, equip your survivor, and turn salvaged materials into weapons and a working shelter.
imageAlt: Silt + Signal v9 gameplay: the equipped survivor at a shelter with a campfire and workbench.
note: Complete standalone Sites v9 game released from commit e9b81ea312df5e137a42ac224847c4adc896102a. Runs directly on GitHub Pages without sign-in or external game assets. All 9 source commits are preserved in history/source-history.bundle. Existing Sites saves stay at the original origin.
previewMethod: Exact v9 Canvas game renderer using the existing shelter test scene.

title: Wayfarer
description: Walk your freighter, work with your crew, and fly cargo between frontier ports and an asteroid outpost.
imageAlt: Wayfarer at Cinder Quay, with the captain, crew, freight terminal, and the freighter ramp.
note: Complete standalone Sites v30 game recovered from commit eacc6f34d17d6d5e7584504188e59b4573a940b1. Runs directly on GitHub Pages without sign-in or external game assets. All 30 source commits are preserved in history/source-history.bundle. Existing Sites saves stay at the original origin.

title: Star Cluster · Geographic Explorer
description: Explore a 100-star cluster, travel between nearby systems, and inspect worlds, coastlines and raised terrain.
imageAlt: Star Cluster v10 screenshot showing the 100-star cluster and blue and red nebulae; the launch opens current v11.
note: Current deployed Sites v11 portable export, byte-identical to the committed artifact, with editable source and tests. Real screenshot is from v10 and shows the unchanged cluster/nebula view; v11 living-world start, terrain relief and navigation improvements are not depicted. Requires WebGL.

title: Wreck Run
description: Tow a damaged freighter through raider territory. Use the wreck as cover and bring its remaining salvage home.
imageAlt: Wreck Run gameplay: a salvage tug towing the damaged Kestrel through an asteroid field.
note: Complete portable Sites v1 release from the verified deployed source. Original game modules preserved; React UI, Three.js, D3 and sound bundled locally. Real v1 gameplay screenshot uses the compatibility renderer.

title: Bramblewild
description: Explore connected woodland trails, villages and dungeons in a procedural 3D action RPG.
imageAlt: Bramblewild v19 gameplay in Hearthwick, with the wayfarer among timbered houses and a campfire.
note: Complete standalone Sites v19 runtime. Original source history is preserved in history/source-history.bundle (20 commits). The screenshot is from the same saved version.

title: Last Light
description: Lead a trench assault through shell holes, smoke and infantry cover to capture the signal station.
imageAlt: Last Light trench assault: the player section in its trench facing the signal station across cratered ground.
note: Complete standalone Sites v1 runtime. Original source history is preserved in history/source-history.bundle (1 commits). The screenshot is from the same saved version.

title: Wayfarer · Pixel Study
description: Explore Cinder Quay in a crisp pixel-art 3D study, with equipment, seating, leaning and ship interactions.
imageAlt: Wayfarer Pixel Study 03: the traveler beside the freighter ramp in a pixel-art Cinder Quay.
note: Complete standalone Sites v3 runtime. Original source history is preserved in history/source-history.bundle (3 commits). The screenshot is from the same saved version.

title: PETRI: Living Lineages
description: A living pond of evolving organisms. Inspect their anatomy, inherited genes, and family histories.
imageAlt: PETRI pond with organism populations and a Mixo anatomy inspector.
note: Recovered v05 web app and v01–v04 releases from the ChatGPT project files. The main entry is the v05 web build. Download the complete modular source from `downloads/`. See [QA notes](QA.md) for prior validation and device limitations. The screenshot is the supplied v05 release capture. The web manifest and service worker use relative scope, so this app is contained within `/petri/living-lineages/`.

title: Inkdrift
description: Pilot a small cartoon ship through a procedural asteroid field and land on illustrated worlds.
imageAlt: Inkdrift spacecraft among asteroids in a blue and purple starfield.
note: Current standalone Inkdrift demo. Inkstar is the early generation, preserved under archive/inkstar/. Old Inkstar entry URLs redirect to the corresponding archived builds. The current Inkdrift runtime is unchanged.

title: Blackpine
description: A procedural-vector survival RPG: scavenge supplies, manage firearms and explore a dangerous woodland.
imageAlt: Blackpine v2 gameplay: the survivor beside a tent, campfire and radio mast, with health and ammunition controls.
note: Standalone saved v2 game, formerly Vector Vale. Preview captured from the current public GitHub Pages build on 2026-09-28.

title: Breach Run
description: A pixel-art demolition game. Break supports and clear a route before the armored transporter arrives.
imageAlt: Breach Run gameplay: the transport lane, destructible supports, and demolition tools.
note: Verified saved version 2 screenshot.

title: Island Three
description: Explore a vast cylindrical space habitat with towns, farmland, bridges and a reflected-sunlight day/night cycle.
imageAlt: Island Three v9 daylight vista: three inhabited valleys, rivers and farmland curve around the cylindrical space habitat beneath its axial rings.
note: Current v9 daylight Vista screenshot captured from the unchanged standalone build on 2026-09-30. Historical v1 screenshot remains preserved under source/.
previewMethod: Unmodified standalone v9 build in local Chromium with SwiftShader WebGL; authored Vista at 12:00, High quality, still refinement.
